---
title: "Mickaël CANOUIL<span class=\"title-suffix\">, Ph.D.</span>"
subtitle: Biostatistician, Quarto wizard, and cinephile.
description: "Senior biostatistician at Alsinova and freelance developer in the Quarto and R ecosystems, pairing genetics and multi-omics analysis with open-source tooling."
image: /assets/images/og-image.png
image-alt: "Social preview card for mickael.canouil.fr: a gold MC monogram above the Mickaël CANOUIL wordmark, over a near-black background."
body-classes: home-page
metadata-files:
  - _about.yml
format:
  mickaelcanouilfr-html:
    grid:
      body-width: 800px
    # Quarto's own obfuscation HTML-escapes the whole anchor and would print
    # the `iconify-icon` tag of the mailto buttons as literal text.
    # `filters/email-obfuscation.lua` covers the document links instead, and
    # the `about` block carries its own encoded href.
    email-obfuscation: none
listing:
  - id: home-featured
    contents:
      - projects/projects.yml
    template: assets/listing-templates/home-featured.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    max-description-length: 160
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [image, title, description, featured]
    # The template keeps three cards, but pagination counts the whole feed and
    # would render a pager below them; one large page removes it.
    page-size: 1000
  - id: home-posts
    contents: posts
    template: assets/listing-templates/blog.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    max-description-length: 220
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    feed: false
  - id: home-publications
    contents:
      - publications/publications.yml
    template: assets/listing-templates/home-publications.ejs.md
    sort: "issued desc"
    categories: false
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    page-size: 1000
---
